name: Wang Wenli
source:
Yuheiguan's proprietor.
He competes with Ming Ming for the position of the king of the criminal underworld.
[spoiler]He's a son of the previous king of heidao, which makes him Ming Ming's cousin and Li Wei's half-brother.[spoiler]
